title: About {{site}}
metaDescription: Free online toolbox: crypto, converters, encoders, web, text and image utilities. Everything runs locally in your browser, nothing is collected or uploaded.
q1Body: {{site}} is a free online toolbox with {{count}} everyday tools: crypto, format converters, encoders, web utilities, text and image tools.
q2Title: Q2: Which tools, and how many?
q2Body: {{count}} tools in total, spread over {{categories}} categories — crypto, encoding, format conversion, image and video work included. All free, no sign-up, open it and use it.
q3Title: Q3: Does the site collect user data?
q3Body: No. Everything runs in your browser — nothing you type leaves the machine. Three things reach out: this page reads star/fork from GitHub's API, IP lookup uses third-party services, and the opt-in AI and Text PV library hit your own endpoint.
q4Title: Q4: Why build this at all?
q4Body: AI could do these jobs too, but that means a workflow to maintain, a task to re-describe and the occasional improvisation to fix. The inputs and outputs were already deterministic — no reason to rebuild the wheel and burn tokens.
q5Title: Q5: What is it built with?
q5Body: A plain frontend single-page app. The build output is a folder of static files you can host on any static platform.
q6Body: Not yet. The site is still in development and in testing; the source will be published as a whole once it is feature-complete. If you need the code in the meantime, message the author directly.
q7Title: Q7: Was this site built with AI?
q7Body: Yes — the whole site was written with AI. A few Skills plus some hard-won vibecoding habits cut the token bill sharply, and the dev docs ended up more complete than when I coded by hand. Qwen3.8-Flash is free right now, so the total development cost came out at zero.
statModelNote: Qoder Agent mode, every change reviewed by hand before it ships
statCodeNote: TypeScript / TSX across 809 files under src, excluding tests and styles
statTokenNote: Cumulative tokens at Qwen3.8-Flash billing rates, context-cache reads included
privacyBody: All computations happen in your browser. Nothing you type is ever uploaded to a server, and there are no accounts, trackers or ads. Q3 and the individual tool pages name the few requests that do go out.
fastBody: Static site, lazily loaded modules, no backend, no tracking, no ads.
openSourceBody: Free, no accounts, no trackers — everyday utilities as static pages you can just open. The source goes public once development is done.
blogDescription: The author's personal blog — Astro with a Firefly-Mod theme, where release notes and technical write-ups for this site are published.
